claims.statement: LoopDaemon.tick() polls pending goals every GOAL_QUEUE_POLL_MS (default 5000 ms): each tick prunes worktrees, resumes approval-blocked goals and settles dependency-blocked goals, then loadQueue() loads goals in created/decomposed status ordered by risk_class descending (critical > high > medium > low) then created_at ascending; up to GOAL_MAX_CONCURRENT (default 4) goals run concurrently — goals executing in-process or parked on unmet depends_on_goal_keys are skipped — with the active-goal set persisted to system_state across restarts.

Objective-mode dispatch is gated by objective-loop-gate.ts: it requires SELF_IMPROVEMENT_OBJECTIVE_LOOP_ENABLED=true (default off), goal metadata.source === 'self-improvement', risk_class 'low', and the per-tick cap (SELF_IMPROVEMENT_OBJECTIVE_LOOP_MAX_PER_TICK, default 1, ceiling 3); a qualifying goal that only loses the cap is deferred to the next tick rather than falling through to the doc-drift no-op.

executeGoal decomposes a created goal via ResourceScheduler.canSchedule (defers with waiting_for_resources; RESOURCE_SCHEDULER_MODE=shadow records the observed-capacity decision without changing it) + GoalDecomposer.decomposeGoalToDAG, then starts the loop via startObjectiveLoop for objective mode or startDocDriftAndSmallFixLoop otherwise — a goal resumed after approval re-opens its existing run via getLoopRun(resume_run_id) — with repository_path from the goal's registered extra repo or LOOP_DAEMON_REPOSITORY_PATH, and creates one prepared maker lease via continueLoopRun with max_assignments 1 / max_maker_workers 1; LOOP_DAEMON_MAKER_RUNTIME is the operator's explicit maker-runtime choice for objective mode.

Under LOOP_BANDIT_ENABLED (with or without an explicit LOOP_DAEMON_MAKER_RUNTIME, which stays on the lease as the fallback when the bandit is on), and never for a resumed or pending evolve sibling, the daemon rewrites the maker lease runtime via chooseSpecies — Thompson sampling over skill_outcomes keyed loop-maker:<loopName>:<runtime>, excluding unfair zeros (infra_failed / no_change / evolve rank loss) and, with OUTCOME_ATTRIBUTION_ENABLED, reviewer/environment losses; first LOOP_BANDIT_SPECIES entry incumbent, challengers below PROMOTE_AFTER (20) outcomes capped to LOOP_BANDIT_MAX_SHARE (default 10 %) — recording bandit_selected (with posterior and max_share) or bandit_skipped events.

Under LOOP_EVOLVE_ENABLED for test-gap/mutation-gap goals (or metadata.evolve === true), the daemon runs up to two sibling makers from LOOP_EVOLVE_SPECIES via retryLoopRun(sibling) — never the species the first maker already ran, and suppressed when the effort controller's goal-id-hash arm is 'off' (EFFORT_SIBLING_RANDOMISE) — then selectEvolveWinner ranks all contenders in code: hard gates first (exit 0, deterministic checks pass, diff within budget and touching the goal's grounding artifact), then mutation score, diff lines, tokens, finish time (GRADED_CONTEST_MODE=act lets a gate-passing maker's SI-A kill share outrank); the winner stays the only non-superseded maker, losers are superseded with their reviewer leases cancelled and each loss recorded as a skill_outcomes row (N7 lineage); with no eligible maker the run fails like a single-maker run (evolve_no_winner).

Maker execution timeouts/diff caps are lane-dependent: the mutation lane (detected via mutationCheckEnv's MUTATE_FILE/MUTATE_TEST) gets 600 s and 400 diff lines, dead-code 2 000, finding-fix 60 (FINDING_FIX_DIFF_MAX) and advisory 1 000 (ADVISORY_DIFF_MAX), other lanes LOOP_MAKER_TIMEOUT_MS (default 300 s, cap 600 s) and 200 lines; deterministic checks are scoped by LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_SCRIPTS (an extra repo uses its own EXTRA_REPO_CHECKS_<SLUG>, never djimitflo's) with LOOP_DAEMON_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS (default 120 s, cap 600 s), and a blocked result retries the maker once via retryLoopRun.

A worker approval wait is parked, not failed: LOOP_WORKER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED causes blockForApproval to set the goal blocked with metadata.awaiting_approval and record a goal_awaiting_approval event; resumeApprovalBlockedGoals keeps waiting while pending and, once approved and its task terminal (completed/failed — the engine resumes the task on approval), resumes on the same run (decomposed + resume_run_id) — inside an immediate transaction that verifies ownership, neither side operator-paused, run resumable and worker not cancelled, otherwise converting the wait to a recorded continuation_hold — and fails the goal with an `approval <status>` reason plus a failed loop_completed event on denied/expired.

The J5 auto-approve: recordAutoApproveShadow (AUTONOMY_SHADOW_ENABLED) records one `auto_approve_shadow` judgment per approval under a conservative rule (test-only, not high-risk/security, >= 3 verified outcomes and no regression in class, model rule-v1); when the rule says yes — or, with ORACLE_LANES_AUTO_APPROVE=true, for an oracle-lane maker the rule declined (Z4, decidedBy 'autonomy:oracle-lane-v1', the rule's verdict still recorded) — and testGapAutoApproveScope returns a single new test file under packages/server/src/__tests__ (LOOP_AUTO_APPROVE_TEST_GAP; M2 mutation-gap lane additionally requires LOOP_AUTO_APPROVE_MUTATION_GAP and >= 1 verified lane run), the daemon pins auto_approved_scope on the lease and decides the approval via decideWorkerApproval with decidedBy 'autonomy:test-gap-rule-v1', while the auto_approved_scope verification gate fails the run if the maker changed anything but that file.

An evolve sibling/retry maker that hits APPROVAL_REQUIRED is approved in-lane when possible: in an auto-approved lane with the run's first auto-approved maker's one-file scope via autoApproveSibling (N6, same 'autonomy:test-gap-rule-v1' rule decision), else via approval inheritance (D4, inheritableApproval's strict rule); a sibling that still needs a human approval propagates APPROVAL_REQUIRED so the goal parks on it and the resumed run ranks that sibling against the first pass's makers (Y0b) instead of spawning new ones or failing it.

Automated review is flag-gated self-review by design: checker leases are created runtime 'manual' (code review is human); with LOOP_DAEMON_AUTOMATED_CHECKER_ENABLED the daemon dispatches the checker's newest prepared lease with the runtime the winning maker attempt used (fallback- and remote-aware), LOOP_DAEMON_AUTOMATED_SECURITY_CHECKER_ENABLED separately gates the security checker, LOOP_REVIEWER_TIMEOUT_MS default 300 s cap 900 s; LOOP_REVIEWER_RETRY_ENABLED gives a reviewer whose runtime gave out one fresh lease, dispatch is skipped (checker_dispatch_skipped) when the maker already failed or ran remote with no local reviewer runtime, LOOP_REVIEWER_STRATEGY=bounded keeps the security checker from being dispatched when the checker produced no decisive verdict, a reviewer still running defers verification, and dispatch errors are recorded as checker_dispatch_failed.

After verifyLoopRun evaluates the gates (maker_completion, diff_threshold_all_makers, checker_verdict, tests_lint_typecheck, auto_approved_scope, security_checker_verdict for high risk, …), completion keeps the strict every-gate-'pass' rule (allGatesPass: draft PR, goal completed) while learners use allGatesPassed (P0-8: a skipped security review on a non-high-risk run counts as a pass); every run feeds the learning layer — one loop_completed bus event, SelfImprovementService.recordOutcome (verified else verificationFailureOutcome/runOutcomeOnFailure: infra_failed on maker timeout/exit-zero/runtime_contract or unknown-only gates, no_change for an empty change, regressed otherwise; verified overrides a prior regressed), one skill_outcomes row per run keyed loop-maker:<loopName>:<runtime> (repo:<slug>: prefixed on extra repos), CommonsProposalReviewService.recordGoalOutcome — and on success LoopDraftPrService.openForRun (LOOP_AUTO_DRAFT_PR_ENABLED) opens a draft PR on the repo the goal's proposal named, held by evidence-freshness enforce and the open-draft throttle.

Goal sources feeding the queue: TestGapSourceService discovers untested live services (discoverTestGaps), untested exported functions (discoverExportGaps, J3), other-Node-workspace and node:test extra-repo gaps (discoverPackageGaps / discoverNodeTestGaps) and mutation-surviving tested services (discoverMutationGaps, M2) — each a grounded proposal capped per day/in flight; DeadCodeSourceService (DEAD_CODE_LANE_ENABLED), FindingFixSourceService and AdvisoryExposureService add dead-code removals, single-finding fixes and dependency bumps; the dream state replays failed loop runs, classifies failure causes once (shadow), and consolidates recurring platform causes into memory candidates and grounded fix proposals; security scan findings route through the specialist-panel reviewed pipeline instead of creating goals directly.

A proposal becomes a daemon-visible goal when a specialist panel reaches 'goal' consensus and agentApproveIfReady (or human approveImprovement) authorizes it; AutonomousGoalGenerator.generateImprovement then inserts a goals row linked by improvement_id with metadata.source 'self-improvement' and risk class derived from proposal type (security high, else low) — immediately with SELF_IMPROVEMENT_GOAL_ON_APPROVE=true, else on the hourly generateFromSelfImprovements sweep — and ImprovementFunnelService.compute() aggregates the whole proposal→verified chain including judgment agreement, panel calibration and cost per verified change.

scripts/auto-deploy.sh (systemd oneshot djimitflo-auto-deploy.service under flock, timer every 10 min) deploys main only when all probes hold: no AUTO_DEPLOY_DISABLED kill switch, main SHA differs from the DJIMITFLO_COMMIT_SHA in compose.yml, every required check context of main's branch protection (read live; unreadable = waiting, never a remembered list) has its newest run on that commit completed with conclusion success — skipped/neutral/missing is not a pass and the producer app_id is part of a check's identity, while non-required checks that fail or run are only logged as info — the commit is at least AUTO_DEPLOY_SETTLE_MIN (default 20) minutes old, and no loop worker is running (worker_leases running plus tasks loop-worker-% running); a held-back main sha is recorded once as a waiting deploy-log event, and every probe is overridable via evaluated AD_<NAME> env vars as exercised by auto-deploy.test.ts.

The deploy runs the operator-installed copy of deploy-vps.sh (host install dir /usr/local/lib/djimitflo, installed by scripts/install-deploy-script.sh): trusted only when it and every directory above are root's and not group/other-writable and the copy still matches its sha256 install record, it is read once into a private dir, hashed and executed as <SHA> --apply --local; the commit's own scripts/deploy-vps.sh is fetched only to compare, and a mismatch pauses auto-deploy via the kill-switch file until the operator installs it (S2: merging a deploy-script change never reaches root). deploy-vps.sh then: requires the deploy root/compose.yml root-owned, requires >= 6 GB free disk after pruning old builds, fetches the exact commit into a fresh root-only dir (FETCH_HEAD must equal the SHA; the receipt binds that commit's git tree), builds djimitflo:main-<short> against the resolved base-image digest and writes a write-once build receipt binding commit, lockfile, Dockerfile, base digest, source tree and image id (verified before the switch; the healthy container's image must match the receipt), chown 1001 the runtime-source checkout (objective-mode worktrees), backs up and rewrites compose.yml (image, DJIMITFLO_COMMIT_SHA, runtime-source mount), force-recreates the container, polls health for 60 s and on unhealthy restores the compose backup and recreates the previous container (rollback, exit 1).

DI-001: every daemon dispatch writes one selection_propensity shadow judgment — tick id grouping, candidate set (capped at 200), chosen goal, propensity honestly recorded as 1.0 under the versioned deterministic policy loop-daemon.queue:risk_desc_created_asc — so task selection is reconstructable for off-policy evaluation; telemetry only, never blocks dispatch.

Multi-repo: a goal whose proposal names a registered extra repo (repo:<slug>, EXTRA_REPOS_ENABLED) runs in that repo's checkout with that repo's own check scripts, and its skill_outcomes carry a repo:<slug>: prefix so no primary-repo fitness or bandit view ever counts them; a goal naming an unregistered repo (or naming one with the flag off) fails with REPO_NOT_REGISTERED instead of running in djimitflo's checkout.

post_deploy_check (P2): once per commit, 15 minutes after a deploy (AUTO_DEPLOY_VERDICT_MIN), auto-deploy compares the stall watch's current subsystems against the deploy baseline and reads the container restart count; a new blocking stall (default panel|goals via AUTO_DEPLOY_REGRESSION_STALLS; provider/host noise is only logged) or any restart writes the reason into AUTO_DEPLOY_DISABLED and pauses auto-deploy — rollback itself stays a human decision.

Fleet drift (S3): every auto-deploy run — also while paused — writes fleet-drift.json into the data mount with, per hand-deployed fleet service (event-bus, agent-registry), the sha256 of the deployed *.py files versus infra/<service>/*.py in the running commit's git tree (read as the clone's owner, hooks and file transport off); a check that cannot be made overwrites the record with an explicit status unknown, never leaving a stale clean record, and the record surfaces at /health.fleet_drift.
